newsitem.title: GERMANY: Rheinmetall to buy Hirschmann - paper.
newsitem.headline: Rheinmetall to buy Hirschmann - paper.

text.p: German armaments firm Rheinmetall AG will take over indebted antenna maker Richard Hirschmann GmbH & Co, the Stuttgarter Zeitung said on Wednesday in a report from its Thursday edition.
The newspaper said that Hirschmann had slipped into the red back into 1991, and had debts of below 200 million marks at the start of this year.

The report also said Hirschmann would remain active in all of its business areas, but said the workforce feared that 10 percent of jobs at its main plant in Neckartenzlingen, which employs 1,700 workers, could be lost.
No comment could immediately be obtained from Rheinmetall.
